parentContract.truthBoundary: This local manifest adopts the asset-level invariant without claiming the FCR candidate is merged or globally authoritative yet.

sourceAuthority.reference: Founder-approved SYNC trilogy visual concepts shared in the ChatGPT conversation on 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-01.
sourceAuthority.rule: The approved source visuals outrank prose fingerprints and current substitute implementation assets for graphic-fidelity decisions.

live-site.reason: Current implementation preserves color/motion vocabulary but does not yet preserve the approved arena composition, people/crowd depth, dominant metallic title, contestant graphics, pressure-clock prominence, or full source-graphic family.

chatgpt-sync.mechanic: surface-only prediction lens before authoritative SYNC answer
chatgpt-sync.reason: Current repo-backed Chat Edition has the prediction mechanic and AI-host element but the approved people-first cobalt scene and full graphic family are not materialized as canonical assets in the repository.

lovable-sync.reason: Lovable is a separate provider/project. Its canonical assets must be tracked at that provider and may not be inferred from this repository.

antiCollapse.rule: Live Site, ChatGPT SYNC and Lovable SYNC must remain recognizable without reading their text labels.
antiCollapse.liveVsChat: Arena crowd/chrome/pressure-show graphics may not collapse into AI-host prediction graphics.
antiCollapse.liveVsLovable: Arena spectacle may not collapse into warm heart-first social-chemistry lounge graphics.
antiCollapse.chatVsLovable: Cobalt AI-host prediction graphics may not collapse into coral/pink human-chemistry graphics.

rollback.strategy: Keep predecessor implementation assets and exact source/runtime evidence until a successor canonical asset family is approved and proven.
rollback.visualTruth: Functional production proof at the last-known-good SHA does not convert the current graphics into founder-approved visual fidelity.

truthBoundary: This manifest records visual source authority and current implementation truth. It does not claim the external approved binaries are repository-owned, that licensing/exportability is proven, that current runtime visually matches the approved concepts, or that a replacement is merge/deploy ready.
